name: Jota Carpanelli
description: Formerly a security researcher and smart contract auditor, now I'm the Head of Security Services at OpenZeppelin. I started working in crypto 6 years ago as a Smart Contract Developer, building OpenZeppelin contracts and development tools. I transitioned into a Security Researcher and have led over 60 audits, discovered more than 20 critical-severity issues, and helped protect over $1 billion in funds, including live protocols.
